Change c0519. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Are you then so easily turned from your design?

1818 text: Did you not call this a glorious expedition? and wherefore was it glorious? Not because the way was smooth and placid as a southern sea, but because it was full of dangers and terror; because, at every new incident, your fortitude was to be called forth, and your courage exhibited; because danger and death surrounded, and these dangers you were to brave and overcome.

1831 text: Did you not call this a glorious expedition? And wherefore was it glorious? Not because the way was smooth and placid as a southern sea, but because it was full of dangers and terror; because, at every new incident, your fortitude was to be called forth, and your courage exhibited; because danger and death surrounded it, and these you were to brave and overcome.

Diff: Did you not call this a glorious expedition? [-and-] {+And+} wherefore was it glorious? Not because the way was smooth and placid as a southern sea, but because it was full of dangers and terror; because, at every new incident, your fortitude was to be called forth, and your courage exhibited; because danger and death surrounded {+it+} , and these [-dangers-] you were to brave and overcome.

Context after (unchanged): For this was it a glorious, for this was it an honourable undertaking.

result.rationale: Capitalizes "And" after the question mark, adds the object "it" after "surrounded," and drops the repeated "dangers" before "you were to brave." These are grammatical and stylistic tidying; Victor's speech to the sailors means the same.
